interface.longDescription: LazyForensic provides professional digital forensics and legal intelligence tools: Korean Law MCP (법제처 법령/판례 검색·인용검증), Korean Writing Reviewer (공문서/감정서 전문 한국어 교정·검토), automated timeline synthesis, timestamp tamper auditing ($MFT/SI vs FN, media metadata), CCTV/Blackbox video analysis with Gemini vision, AI video editing & filmstrip rendering, AntV Infographic generation, KakaoTalk & mobile chat extraction, DLP & leakage cross-correlation, and court-admissible forensic report drafting for Daeryun Law Forensic Center.
